ressort.fehler: The ministry cannot be handed over right now.
ressort.zusage.keins: No ministry is left that could go to the party; the promise stays open.
ressort.zusage.ok: The {partei} takes over {ressorts, list}; the promise is kept.
wort.bauamnestie.ausgang: The construction amnesty is adopted and stays in force: illegal buildings can be legalised for a fee.
wort.cyber.ausgang: An emergency plan is adopted and critical networks are hardened.
wort.fonds.ausgang: The extra revenue goes to paying down debt and a reserve for the coming years.
wort.fonds.titel: Direct extra revenue into a fund
wort.gas.diversifiziert: New supply contracts for liquefied gas are signed; part of the supply shifts to LNG.
wort.gas.kurz: The contract is extended by one year; the shares do not change.
wort.gas.verlaengert: The contract with {land} is extended long-term; a larger share of the gas now comes from there.
wort.kanal.begonnen: Construction of the canal begins; costs, duration and progress are shown in the construction file.
wort.kanal.ohne_bau: The canal is politically decided, but construction cannot start yet: {grund}
wort.krieg.paket_sieg: A buffer zone under Turkish control, reparations and security guarantees: the hard cut, a triumph at home and a lasting dispute abroad. The border itself stays where it is.
wort.krieg.paket_zugestaendnis: Border concessions and reparations: Turkey withdraws from positions in the border area and pays. It buys calm at the price of fall risk, coup risk and dependence.
wort.krieg.teil_pufferzone: Buffer zone under Turkish control, without a border change (standing {ansehen}: even a victor's peace has a price in the world)
wort.krieg.teil_zugestaendnis: Border concessions (officer trust −15: the officer corps does not forget)
wort.kueste.begonnen: A road programme in Antalya, Muğla and İzmir begins; progress is shown in the construction file.
wort.kueste.ohne_bau: A building programme is announced, but construction cannot start yet: {grund}
wort.partner.eins.ausgang: The {partei} takes over {ressorts, list}; the second ministry is still outstanding.
wort.partner.eins.text: Costs 2 capital; {ressorts, list} goes to the {partei}. The promise stays open and falls due again in three months.
wort.partner.vertagen.ausgang: The answer is postponed; the promise stays open.
wort.partner.vertagen.text: Costs nothing; no ministry changes hands, the promise stays open, patience wears thin.
wort.partner.zuwendung.ausgang: The {partei} gets attention and stays in the bloc; its demand remains on the list.
wort.partner.zuwendung.text: Costs 4 capital; the party gets attention and stays in the bloc. Its concrete demand stays open as a promise.
wort.partner.zwei.ausgang: The {partei} takes over {ressorts, list}; the promise is kept.
wort.partner.zwei.text: Costs 4 capital; {ressorts, list} go to the {partei}, with new ministers from its ranks. The promise is kept.
wort.sicherheitspaket.ausgang: A security package is adopted: police and gendarmerie get more staff and powers permanently.
wort.streikverbot.ausgang: Strikes are banned and union rights are restricted permanently; the unions call it an attack on their rights.
